==============
Epic Biography (Nicolaus Corpernicus)
==============

Pegasus Feather X 5: Reward of the 1st Chapter

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Awarded to those who complete the 2nd chapter of Copernicus' storyline. Guide:

Chapter 1 “Studying abroad in Italy”
Venice → (30 days of sailing?) Rome → (30 days of sailing?) Danzig → (Number of days needs to pass. 60 days?) Venice

Chapter 2 “Short essay”
Danzig → London → Athens → Southwest coast of Sumatra (red flower at northeastern end) → Danzig

Chapter 3 “Astronomical Observation” Delivering the Sextant of Wisdom
in Danzig → (60 days of sailing?) Rome → Danzig Recipe

Chapter 4 “Rotation of the Celestial Sphere”
Rome → Danzig
Ended with above

Completion also awards a +1 to Astronomy max skill as well (r20 -> r21). Please keep in mind, you cannot complete more than one chapter per real life day. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?TheLivesOfHeros/NicolausCopernicus

comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
Getting the Sextant of Wisdom for Chapter 3 looks like quite a bit of work.

The Sextant can be found in Beirut Mosque with search 3+ (more then 3 is recommended)

Everyone who has the needed Alchemy 11 for this recipe should have no problem getting Seal of Sorcery and Ignis Solution.

But Element of Wisdom comes out of Legacy TH3. Precise Artillery Calculator and on top of that the recipe only has a 20% success rate.

comments.author: CA-RvZ
comments.body: Correction: Abacus of General Guan instead of Gaocheng Astronomical Observatory to unlock Sextant of Wisdom recipe
